cohort: 143 patients with meconium-stained amniotic fluid were divided into two groups: 50 receiving amnioinfusion (study group) and 93 not receiving amnioinfusion (control group).
finding: Amnioinfusion was found to be useful in reducing perinatal morbidity without any maternal risk.
mod_finding: Perinatal mortality does seem to be affected by mode of delivery; the only stillbirth in the study group and all perinatal deaths in the control group occurred in babies delivered by cesarean section.
